entities.summary: The Basilica of Our Lady of Copacabana is a 17th-century Marian shrine that houses the image of Our Lady of the Candles of Copacabana]. It is located in the town of Copacabana, Bolivia on the shores of Lake Titicaca. Under this Marian title, the Blessed Virgin Mary is designated patroness saint of Bolivia.
